title: PPIA-14 Accessibility, Mobile, Nonvisual and Localization Requirements
interpolation_rules: Every interpolation variable is allowlisted after authorization and disclosure reduction.
Do not pass hidden names, hidden IDs, hidden counts, policy internals, secrets, raw diagnostics or unauthorized reason details.
Pluralization/count grammar may only use already-visible authorized counts.
Do not build sentences by concatenating fragments whose order or grammar assumes English.
Internal status/diagnostic codes remain separate from localized user-facing keys.
Visual and screen-reader variants may differ in phrasing only if their safe semantic meaning and disclosure ceiling are equivalent.
copy_status: No final localized strings are established by this Foundation; only stable semantic keys/fields and constraints are defined.
